name: Dev-via-Spec Pipeline
description:
Multi-phase research → architect → builder arc that produces an external integration end-to-end. Coordinator instantiates with target framework and sandbox image; researcher plans against the framework substrate; architect emits the spec; builder authors the integration code; qa-reviewer validates.

Phase 2a skeleton — body is a valid flow shape that passes Flow.Validate but does not yet wire the agentic components or sandbox bootstrap. Phase 2b expands the body to include the legacy configs/osh-demo.json topology (dev-via-spec-style rules, builder workspace, test-harness catalog binding), with parameter substitution at LLM-author-controllable knobs only.
body:
{
  "id": "dev-via-spec-{{.target_slug}}",
  "name": "Dev-via-Spec: {{.target_framework}}",
  "description": "Researcher → architect → builder → qa-reviewer chain producing an integration for {{.target_framework}} (sandbox_image={{.sandbox_image}}, max_iterations={{.max_iterations}}, model={{.model}})",
  "version": 0,
  "runtime_state": "not_deployed",
  "nodes": [],
  "connections": []
}

parameters.name: target_framework
parameters.description: Human-readable name of the framework or system the builder integrates against (e.g. 'OSH driver', 'Kafka Connect', 'OpenTelemetry collector'). Shown in the flow name.

parameters.name: target_slug
parameters.description: Kebab-case slug of the target framework. Used in the flow ID. Coordinator derives from target_framework.

parameters.name: sandbox_image
parameters.description: Container image the builder workspace bootstraps. Match the target framework's runtime — e.g. 'openjdk:21' for Java-based frameworks, 'python:3.12' for Python.

parameters.name: max_iterations
parameters.description: Maximum builder loop iterations before terminal. Multi-phase dev-via-spec arcs typically need 10-20.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: LLM endpoint name from the model_registry. Builder/architect phases benefit from frontier models; researcher can use claude-haiku.
